about: Windows programs Run this app knows. Each entry's names are prefix names (what Run this app makes of a download's file name, such as discord for DiscordSetup.exe); a name matches it exactly or as the start of a longer one. store: the Flathub app ID offered first. launcher: a store's own launcher, installed with Run this app; its note says what to expect. package: a Microsoft Store package (MSIX) or a setup program that only fetches one, which OrielOS can't run; alternative is where to get the app instead.

apps.name: Epic Games Launcher
apps.note: Epic's launcher installs, then its games appear in Start as you install them. It can be slow to start the first time.
